name: hero-ceviche
prompt: Professional overhead food photography of an authentic Peruvian ceviche de pescado served in a wide shallow white ceramic bowl: glossy cubes of fresh white fish marinated in lime juice (leche de tigre), thin slices of purple red onion, chopped fresh cilantro, small red aji limo pepper rings, a round slice of orange sweet potato (camote), a piece of large-kernel Peruvian corn (choclo) and toasted cancha corn on the side, halved green limes. The bowl sits on a pale sky-blue table with a folded navy blue linen napkin. Bright natural daylight, crisp, fresh, vibrant appetizing colors, high detail, shallow depth of field, clean minimal coastal style. No text, no logos, no people.
